verdict.rationale: A SaaS platform that ships a CLI, SDKs and a hosted MCP server could plausibly offer a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents such an opt-out for Bento's own users. The subscriber anonymization endpoint and the tracking-script docs cover end-subscriber data handling and Bento's own tracking feature, which are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit here.
